```instr
DEFINE INSTRUMENT improved_sans_collimation(lambda0=6, dlambda=0.05)
TRACE

COMPONENT source = Source_simple(
  radius = 0.03,
  dist = 3,
  focus_xw = 0.01,
  focus_yh = 0.01,
  lambda0 = lambda0,
  dlambda = dlambda,
  flux = 1e13
) AT (0, 0, 0) ABSOLUTE

COMPONENT pin1 = Slit(
  radius = r_pin1,
  xwidth = 2*r_pin1,
  yheight = 2*r_pin1
) AT (0, 0, 3) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT monitor1 = PSD_monitor(
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.02,
  nx = 100,
  ny = 100,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 3.01) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT pin2 = Slit(
  radius = r_pin2,
  xwidth = 2*r_pin2,
  yheight = 2*r_pin2
) AT (0, 0, 6) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT monitor2 = PSD_monitor(
  xwidth = 0.02,
  yheight = 0.02,
  nx = 100,
  ny = 100,
  restore_neutron = 1
) AT (0, 0, 6.01) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT sample = Isotropic_Scatterer_sphere(
  radius = 0.005,
  xwidth = 0.01,
  yheight = 0.01,
  focus_xw = 0.06,
  focus_yh = 0.06,
  target_index = 1,
  target_x = 0,
  target_y = 0,
  target_z = 3,
  Sample_D = 1.0
) AT (0, 0, 6) RELATIVE source

COMPONENT beamstop = Beamstop(
  xwidth = 0.06,
  yheight = 0.06,
  radius = 0.03
) AT (0, 0, 0.01) RELATIVE sample

COMPONENT detector = PSD_monitor(
  xwidth = 0.6,
  yheight = 0.6,
  nx = 300,
  ny = 300
) AT (0, 0, 3) RELATIVE sample

COMPONENT monitor_scattered = Monitor(
  xwidth = 0.6,
  yheight = 0.6,
  nx = 1,
  ny = 1
) AT (0, 0, 3) RELATIVE sample

PARAMETER r_pin1 = 0.01
PARAMETER r_pin2 = 0.01

SET ncount = 1e6
SET seed = 12345

END
```
